edits: detect when the input signal changes from 0 in one clock cycle to 1 the next (similar to positive edge detection). The output bit should be set the cycle after a 0 to 1 transition occurs.
detect when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next (similar to negative edge detection). The output bit should be set the cycle after a 1 to 0 transition occurs.
